About me

I'm Muhammad Sufiyan Kamal — a frontend developer and AI filmmaker who loves turning an idea into something people can watch, use, and feel.

My film work is where it started. I directed and generated The Ancient Crown Heist, a detective mystery AI short film, and THE LAST SIGNAL, a cinematic sci-fi thriller told in ten parts — handling everything from the AI-generated scenes and trailers to the original soundtracks and the final edit.

On the web side, I build clean, minimal websites with modern HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React — including the ICT project site for The Ancient Crown Heist and the DUET 26 student showcase. Whether it's a film or a webpage, my process is the same: plan the story, design every frame with intent, and finish it properly.

  • Frontend development
